facts.activity_file: providing and briefing a fire watch

assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: corrective action - critical control at PSV-4210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on PSV-4210 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in authorising hot work, specifically providing and briefing a fire watch. PSV-4210 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during shift handover while the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 5 November 2021 a corrective action on PSV-4210 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility was reviewed against the critical control it was raised to restore.
